newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-GREECE MISS PENALTY IN GOALESS DRAW WITH PORTUGAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREECE MISS PENALTY IN GOALESS DRAW WITH PORTUGAL.

text.p: Portugal's goalkeeper Vitor Baia blocked a penalty shot in the 68th minute in a goaless friendly draw with Greece on Wednesday, where Portugal was in control in the first half and Greece in the second.
The match was a test before next month's World Cup qualifiers where Greece will play away against Bosnia and Portugal against Ireland.

The Portoguese were looking for a confidence-beating performance after their 2-0 home defeat against France in another friendly last month and had two chances in the first half to net with Barcelona's Luis Figo and Fernando Couto in the 8th and 27th minutes.

The Greeks were the better of the two sides in the second half with a fierce foul shot on the poll from 20 metres by Costas Franzeskos in the 50th and a slightly wide headshot by young AEK striker Demis Nikolaidis in the 60th.
The hosts had their best chance seven minutes later when Nikolaidis won a penalty after Baia tackled him inside the box in a face-to-face encounter.
But the Barcelona goalkeeper denied victory to the Greeks, blocking the penalty shot by Franzeskos.
Portugal played without star midfielder Rui Costa of Italy's Fiorentina and Porto central defender Jorge Costa, both out with injuries.
"I am generally satisfied. It was a good test," Portoguese national coach Artur Jorge said.
